description: Lists guests in the selected wedding who are recorded as 13 or older, with contact details and RSVP status. Optional filters narrow results by RSVP status or name. Guests under 13 or with unconfirmed ages are excluded, as are guest notes and dietary details. Requires sign-in.

search.description: Search guests by name. A first name, a last name, or the whole name all match.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: list_my_guests
title: List My Wedding Guests
